name: smwsprites-buster-beetle
title: Buster Beetle
description:
The Buster Beetle from Super Mario Bros. 3. It will walk (falling off ledges). It will pick up any Throw Blocks in its way and throw them at Mario in attempt to hurt him. Any attack can defeat it.

Make sure to specify the sprite number (from list.txt) of the block (buster_block.cfg) in buster.asm! Check the ASM files for customization options.
